import json, os, glob
base="/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts"
for d in sorted(glob.glob(base+"/*"), key=os.path.getmtime):
    mtime=os.path.getmtime(d)
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime)
    if dt.date().isoformat()!="2026-10-13":
        continue
    files=glob.glob(d+"/*.jsonl")
    if not files: 
        continue
    path=files[0]
    users=[]
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line=line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            try:
                o=json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            role=o.get("role") or o.get("type") or ""
            # various schemas
            text=""
            if isinstance(o.get("message"), dict):
                c=o["message"].get("content")
                if isinstance(c, str): text=c
                elif isinstance(c, list):
                    parts=[]
                    for p in c:
                        if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") in ("text","input_text"):
                            parts.append(p.get("text") or "")
                        elif isinstance(p, str):
                            parts.append(p)
                    text="\n".join(parts)
            elif isinstance(o.get("content"), str):
                text=o["content"]
            if role in ("user","human") or o.get("type") in ("user","human"):
                t=text.strip().replace("\n"," ")[:240]
                if t:
                    users.append(t)
    print(f"\n== {dt.strftime('%H:%M')} {os.path.basename(d)[:8]} user_msgs={len(users)} ==")
    for u in users[:3]:
        print(" -", u[:220])

import json
from datetime import datetime
p="/Users/mac/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"
# file may be huge; scan lines containing 2026-10-13
n=0
with open(p) as f:
    for line in f:
        if "2026-10-13" not in line and "2026-10-12T16" not in line:
            # timestamps might be UTC so 10-13 CST is 10-12 16:00 UTC through 10-13 13:30 UTC
            pass
        if "2026-10-13" not in line and "2026-10-12T1" not in line and "2026-10-12T2" not in line:
            continue
        try:
            o=json.loads(line)
        except Exception:
            continue
        ts=str(o.get("ts") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("time") or "")
        text=o.get("text") or o.get("body") or o.get("content") or ""
        if isinstance(text, dict):
            text=json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=False)
        text=str(text)
        # filter roughly today CST: utc >= 2026-10-12T16:00
        blob=json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
        if "2026-10-13" not in blob and "2026-10-12T1" not in blob and "2026-10-12T2" not in blob:
            continue
        kind=o.get("kind") or o.get("type") or o.get("mode") or ""
        bus=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or ""
        src=o.get("source") or o.get("from") or ""
        snippet=text.replace("\n"," ")[:180]
        if not snippet:
            snippet=blob[:180]
        n+=1
        if n<=40:
            print(f"{ts} kind={kind} from={src} id={bus} | {snippet}")
print("TOTAL_MATCH_LINES_PRINTED_CAP", n)
